sn22.151:1.2: _Kiṁ upādāya_ might be rendered as “derived from what”, but the fact that it is parallel with _abhinivissa_ (“insist”) shows that the sense “grasping” is prominent. Grasping is the “taking up” of the view of self, which hardens into “insistence”.
sn22.151:1.5: This is another context that emphasizes the “existence” of the aggregates (see [sn22.94:1.5]() and note).
